text:
Mira Patel: dropped a compact mock — trying a tiny hollow dot for required fields + an optional focus reveal that shows the word 'Required'. figma: https://figma.redwood/company/console-req-v3

Evan Torres: visual declutter is nice. worried about scannability in dense tables. dots could be missed when skimming. :eyes:

Priya Desai: agree. how about dot by default, show 'Required' on focus/hover, and always set aria-required on inputs? that keeps SRs happy.

Joey Kim: dev note: show inline error on blur only if field non-empty; show summary at top after submit with links to anchors. prevents noisy warnings while typing.

Kevin Liu: accessibility checklist: aria-required=true, aria-describedby linking to the error id, role=alert for inline errors when they appear. for summary links, set tabindex=-1 and focus the field when clicked so screen readers move properly.

Mira Patel: typed-confirm question — keep for org/workspace deletes? or use checkbox + modal? I'm leaning typed-confirm for irreversible resources.

Priya Desai: typed-confirm for org/workspace, checkbox+confirmation for batch deletes. add undo snackbar for recoverable deletes (7-8s). copy: "Type the workspace name to confirm deletion."

Evan Torres: analytics: let's A/B dot vs asterisk for new orgs and track empty-submit rate + support mentions.

Joey Kim: implementation gotcha: avoid duplicate announcements (summary + inline). only one should be role=alert. also restore focus after modals close.

design-bot: reminder: add this to Thu design review agenda. :spiral_calendar:

Mira Patel: action items: design will add focus 'Required' state (Priya + Mira), eng to add ARIA wiring and non-duplicated alerts (Kevin + Joey), analytics to spec A/B (Evan), PM to draft typed-confirm policy. I'll post updated frames by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:
